'''Jefris''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Shortly after the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Battle of Kothlis]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Jefris returned to his [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] until he realized that his men were not at their posts. When he searched the hangar, he discovered that [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was the one who ordered Jefris's men to take a break without the commander's permission. Jefris was enraged and argued with Skywalker since he didn't have the right to order his men to leave their posts.
